name: classes-m9-m10
description: The original C Borg against better-borg-c milestones 9 and 10, for every class and race (classes-1800, the standard 100,000-turn suite). Default profile only: a 3-seed smoke check (m9-m10-munchkin-smoke) confirmed munchkin-wdr is a no-op on both milestones, identical play/trace hashes on 3/3 seeds each - their own default already is the munchkin start by class, inherited unchanged from M8.

The file stays as run; the site labels these runs pre-cutoff and excludes their straddling comparisons. The restarted class grid is classes-explicit (munchkin-class against normal on 4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661).
